data.summary: `git commit -- .ddflow/events/close-uxcaps.jsonl` on main spent over 120 s in hooks (check-msg alone was still running at 124 s), then failed with "cannot lock ref 'HEAD': is at d0f77a30d but expected b58ace530" because another lane committed meanwhile. That lane's commit d0f77a30d had swept up the file staged in the shared index, so the log landed under another lane's message. An events-only commit should skip the slow hooks and go through one serialized path.
data.title: Committing a lane's event log on shared main takes over 2 minutes of hooks and loses the HEAD race

data.body:
Fixes bug B-events-commit-races-shared-main: `git commit -- .ddflow/events/close-uxcaps.jsonl` on main spent over 120 s in hooks (check-msg alone was still running at 124 s), then failed with "cannot lock ref 'HEAD': is at d0f77a30d but expected b58ace530" because another lane committed meanwhile. That lane's commit d0f77a30d had swept up the file staged in the shared index, so the log landed under another lane's message. An events-only commit should skip the slow hooks and go through one serialized path.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-events-commit-races-shared-main --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-events-commit-races-shared-main --regression-test <test>` first).
